title: What is a product?
summary: This is a Hacker News discussion post about an article exploring the fundamental definition of what constitutes a 'product'. The post received moderate engagement with 40 points and 17 comments from the tech community.
problem_solved: It explores the foundational question of how products are defined in business and technology contexts.
why_valuable: Provides conceptual clarity on product definition which is fundamental for entrepreneurs, product managers, and anyone building solutions.
